messages.subject: Saudi Executive Search Introduction | Government Relations, ESG & Country Leadership
messages.body:
Dear Cander Team,

Your Riyadh executive-search practice and focus on senior leadership across KSA makes this a relevant introduction. I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group, leading government and regulatory relations, ESG and social performance, corporate and external affairs, stakeholder strategy, strategic partnerships and executive communications. Saudi Arabia is my first-priority market, and I am pursuing Director, VP, Country and Regional leadership appointments where transformation depends on institutional relationships and disciplined execution.

My executive CV is attached for confidential consideration.

Best regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
ragunauthramsaroop@icloud.com
